Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1249
Claimant:
Brenda Christian
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
13 Jun 2023
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision. The insured reports a front-end impact at a slow speed
in a parking area, and the claimant was reported as a passenger in the other vehicle.
18 Sep 2023
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and coverage was in force on the reported date of loss.
No issues with the policy status were found.
6 Oct 2023
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision and matches the location
and general sequence described by the insured.
15 Oct 2023
Photos of both vehicles were reviewed. The damage is mostly consistent with the described impact, and the pattern
of contact points lines up with a head-on collision at low speed.
20 Oct 2023
Took a recorded statement from the other driver, who confirmed the accident happened as described. An
independent witness also gave a matching account of the impact.
8 Nov 2023
Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact will go through the attorney's office, and the
representation letter is on file.
9 Nov 2023
Received the claimant's medical records and the initial treatment notes. The reported back strain fits the kind and
force of the crash well.
6 Dec 2023
Records show the claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years. That prior condition appears
to add to the current complaints, and this is noted for the file.
18 Dec 2023
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. The treating provider's notes explain the
reasons, and the timeline is being reviewed against standard recovery expectations.
13 Jan 2024
Checked the vehicle's repair and inspection history. No earlier dmaage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests
the damage predates the coverage start date.
17 Jan 2024
Each contact with the claimant, through the attorney and directly, has produced the same account of the accident.
The file is being prepared for the next review with the medical and repair documentation attached.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
